lines.x: Whatever you need me to do, just give the order—so long as it's something I can do. Anything I'd be unwilling to do? If I have to name one, please try not to send me to kill innocent people. Yes. I have nothing else to add.

In the organizations I used to belong to, the people who gave the orders all required that we address them as 'Commander,' 'Sir,' 'Captain,' or with formal speech. If that's what you'd like, I'll do the same. There's no such rule here? Understood.
这些需要我手写的文书工作，还是请你再考虑一下，我写的字嘛……我也试过练字，但成果就是现在这样。你看，没有只要愿意花时间就一定能做得比别人好的道理。

I have no reason to refuse cooperating with that Sarkaz from Medical and her research, though I don't see what research value there is in being unable to grow up. In Bolívar there are plenty of children who died before ever reaching adulthood. I merely happen to still be alive.

I can no longer remember how many people, before their final moment came, asked me to go and see that future in their place—the one where no one else has to be sacrificed. I had no way to refuse. But all I could ever see was the next person telling me the same thing. One after another.

My reason for coming to Rhodes Island? You won't like hearing it. Honestly, I can't understand a single person who casts their life away for something they're pursuing, so all I can do is imitate them and try to understand. Besides not wanting to die, I don't have any goal I want to pursue anyway.
我听过那个童话故事。但你看，我不会飞，也没有不要长大的想法，更不会“处理”掉即将长大的同伴们。嗯？不太对吗？我印象里好像是有这样一段，是隔了太久记错了吗……
请不要把我当小孩子看待……既然有得选，那偏爱烤肉和汽水也很正常吧。与其说小孩子喜欢挑食，不如说大家在面对小孩子时总会觉得自己有资格说对方挑食。
我最近的生活好像有点太安心，也太开心了。不，我不是说这有什么不好的，只是……我也不知道。如果我开始变得安于现状，这会是对一些人的辜负和背叛吗？
Don't mind me, I'm not sleepy yet. If you're tired, go ahead and rest first.
Codename Pedro. As of today I'm officially an operator of Rhodes Island. I'll familiarize myself with your company's business as quickly as I can. I hope we work well together. Yes.
Compared to these, what I used to carry out can hardly be called tactics at all.
It seems you're reasonably satisfied with how I've performed. That makes me happy.
Me? Are you really sure? Ah—it's just that I'm a little excited, which is rare for me. As you know, those generals would never regard a child as a resource of any value.
I'll cooperate fully with this tactical execution.
I've received the tactical projection. Please give me my next instruction.
We'll all come back alive.
The enemy's deployment matches the projection. Executing our tactics as planned.
Understood.
I'll carry it out.
I'm on my way.
I've arrived. Awaiting the next order.
Put down your weapon.
Stop resisting.
Executing covering fire.
We're all going to survive.
你用最小的代价结束了这场灾难……谢谢你。
We won. We stopped more innocent people from being killed. Right.
你遏止了进一步的打击，但愿我们的敌人不会给别处带去更多痛苦与死亡……
Don't be upset. We're all still alive, and that matters more than anything.
Send me anywhere you like. It's your call.
Mm? Don't do that, it tickles.
别把我当小孩子……唉，随便你吧。
Arknights.
又过了一年。以前我会有点分不清今年和去年，还有再之前的每一年，它们之间到底有什么区别……但这一年我确实见到了一些值得被记住的新东西，真好。希望我不会太快忘记它们。
You're back. Nothing is better than that.

Today's your birthday, isn't it. Yes, you never told me. Your memory isn't wrong. It's just that last year I saw everyone giving you gifts, so I made a note on my terminal's calendar. Anyway. Happy birthday. Take good care of the present.
“……在这充满意义的日子，希望我和博士也能回顾过去的收获，再次实现自我的——”嗯，怎么了？很奇怪，不用背诵了？好吧，被你看出来我找人帮忙准备了稿子，我真的不太懂这个。
